snippet.title: THE FIELD BETWEEN LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
Buy it on Steam during it's launch week for a 10% discount: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962310/The_Field_Between/
Or pick up the Ghosts and Gardening bundle for The Field Between and Anamnesis at a 15% discount: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59621/Ghosts_and_Gardening/

Get the demo on itch for free: https://thebigisaac.itch.io/the-field-between-demo

The Field Between is a psychological horror farming simulator where you tend to your small farm, gradually progressing from humble beginnings to running a farming empire. Plant, harvest, sell, sleep. Just try to ignore anything out of the ordinary.
